Commentary.Commentary: Ireland managed to get some sort of an understanding of the pitch with an unbeaten 67-run stand for the 7th wicket but one feels that it came a bit too late. Still, if they manage to pick up 2-3 wickets in the Powerplay for less than 40 runs, you never know. Stay tuned...

When Paul Stirling was dropped early, it seemed like it was going to be his night. But Afghanistan just are way too professional. Just as a balanced human being puts his life's troubles behind him and keeps looking for the future, the Men In Blue just kept thinking ahead. The wickets kept tumbling one after the other with everyone bowling well, barring Farid Malik, who was not too bad either.

Hmmm... to end with 132 from 65/6 is definitely a reasonable effort. But if Afghanistan were to be told that they would be chasing less than 140 at the toss, they would definitely take it. The pitch looks a good one to bat on and 133 is definitely chaseable.

SIX! A biggie to end the innings! A short ball outside off, delivered slowly, Dockrell picks the change in pace, walks across, gets down on a knee and swats it over mid-wicket! IRELAND FINISH ON 132/6!
Last ball then... Four? Six? Wicket?
Yorker on middle, dug out to the off side for a quick run.
Full and around off, Dockrell gets a long way across as he looks to flick but misses. Is hit on the pads and there is an LBW appeal but no one is caring.
Full and outside off, chipped wide of long off for a couple.
FOUR! A full toss, around middle and leg. Dockrell helps it to the fine leg fence!
A slower ball outside off, on a length, firmly struck through the covers for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Poynter cuts it towards point for a run.
SIX! Good use of the feet. Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Poynter comes down the track and lofts it over long on for a biggie. 50-RUN STAND IS UP. Some sort of respectability now...
That kept low. Tossed up on off, Poynter looks to cut but gets beaten on this one due to low bounce.
Short delivery, Dockrell pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up on off, Dockrell drives it to covers.
Bowls a googly on off, Poynter makes room and hits it over mid off. The batsmen take a single.
Short on off, Poynter slaps it through covers for a run.
Length delivery on middle, Dockrell punches it towards mid on for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Dockrell flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
That ball has taken the inside edge and thudded into his pads. One run added to the total.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Farid Malik returns. 2-0-13-0 so far.
Floated on middle, Poynter sweeps it towards square leg for a run.
Full on middle, Dockrell drives it towards mid on for a run.
Short delivery, Poynter pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR LEG BYES! Floated on middle and leg, Poynter looks to play the reverse sweep but misses it and gets hit on the pads. It goes towards fine leg. The fielder chases it but in vain. Rashid Khan appealed but no one to support.
Comes down the track and pushes it to long on for a run.
Outside off, chopped down to third man for a single.
Rashid Khan to bowl out now.
That ball has taken the inside edge and thudded into the pads.

SAFE AS A HOUSE. Short delivery on middle, Poynter looks to pull but gets a top edge. It goes towards short fine leg. The fielder collects it and throws it at the keeper's end. The keeper whips the bails off in a flash and appeals. It is referred upstairs and replays show that the batsman was well in.
Run out appeal! Looks safe...
Tossed up on off, Poynter looks to cut but gets a bottom edge. It goes to the keeper on one bounce.
Floated on middle, Dockrell sweeps it towards square leg for a run.
FOUR! Good shot. Flighted delivery on leg, Poynter sweeps it fine towards fine leg for a boundary.
Flighted delivery on middle, Poynter flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman to bowl out. 3-0-13-1 so far.
Short delivery, Poynter pulls it over mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Nice shot. Plays it very fine. Floated on off, Poynter plays a late guide towards third man for a boundary. The fielder had no chance there.
Flighted delivery on off, Poynter plays a reverse sweep towards third man.
Floated on middle, Poynter defends it off the front foot.
On the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and fast, at the stumps, blocked back to the bowler.
Sharafuddin Ashraf to have a go now. Bowls left-arm off spin.
Tossed up on middle, Dockrell looks to defend but it goes of the inner half of the bat. It goes towards mid-wicket. The batsmen take a run.
Short and outside off, Dockrell cuts it through point. The batsmen get two runs.
Floated on middle, Poynter drives it towards the bowler where Khan dives but it goes through him. It goes towards mid on. The batsmen take a run.
Full on off, Poynter plays it towards third man.
Landed outside off, dabbed to short third man for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Dockrell nudges it towards the leg side for a run.
Full on middle, Ponyter drives it towards mid on for a run.
Floated on middle and leg, Dockrell sweeps it towards square leg for a run.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Poynter sweeps it through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Nice improvisation from Poynter. Flighted delivery on middle, Poynter plays a reverse sweep towards point for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle, Poynter defends it off the front foot.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Dockrell flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Stuart Poynter walks in at number 8, replacing Getkate.

OUT! LBW! Second wicket in the over! Rashid is flying already. Full and fast, in line of the stumps, Getkate looks to sweep but misses. Is hit right in front of the stumps and the umpire does not take long to raise the finger. This team may not even play 20 overs.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Shane Getkate is in at number 7, replacing Thompson.

OUT! TIMBER! The leg spinner from Rashid. Rashid Khan strikes in his first over. Flighted delivery on leg, Thompson looks to play a sweep shot but misses it completely and gets bowled. Ireland lose half their side. The visitors lose their fifth wicket.
Starts with a short delivery on middle, Dockrell pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen take a run.
Rashid Khan finally comes on to bowl.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
A short ball around off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.

RUN OUT CHANCE! MISSED! Oh dear... what luck for Thompson. Floated on middle, Stuart flicked it towards mid-wicket. Two fielders get across from square leg and one of them throws the ball to the keeper. Now, there is some confusion between the batsmen as Dockrell is not ready to run while Thompson wants the second. But on seeing Dockrell stationary, Thompson stops dead. Now Dockrell starts to run but Thompson gives up. He is gone for all money but luckily for him, the ball shoots below and the poor keeper has no chance. Laughs all around.
Full and around off, Thompson looks to sweep but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Around off, pushed towards point.
Good length delivery on off, Dockrell plays it towards point.
Short of a length delivery, Thompson looks to pull but gets a top edge towards square leg. It falls in no man's land. The batsmen take a run.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Thompson looks to pull but misses it.
Good ball from Janat. Good length delivery on middle and leg, Thompson looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Length delivery on off, Dockrell plays it towards point for a run.
Full again on middle, Thompson drives it towards mid on for a run.
FOUR! Fantastic shot from Stuart. Full and wide outside off, Thompson drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary.
Full and around middle, worked straight to short mid-wicket. 2 runs and a wicket from the over, Nabi's figures read 2-0-4-2!
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single to get off the mark.
George Dockrell walks in at number 6, replacing Simi.

OUT! Stumped! The arm ball does the trick for Nabi and he has his second in the span of 6 balls. Bowled outside off, Singh comes down the track to defend but misses the line completely and gets stumped. Probably the bowler sensed that the batsman is going to dance. Accordingly changed the music. Decent glovework by Shafiqullah Shafaq.
Tossed up on middle, Thompson flicks it through mid-wicket. The fielder tries to collect it cleanly but fumbles it. The batsmen take a run.
Goes back and tucks it around the corner through square leg for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Length delivery on off, Thompson plays it towards point. The batsmen pick up a couple. 50 UP FOR IRELAND. Big over. 11 runs have come from it.
Short delivery, the batsman pulls it towards fine leg for a run.
SIX! First six of the match. HAMMERED AWAY! Length delivery on middle, Singh comes down the track and lofts this over long on for a biggie.
Full on off, Thompson drives it through covers for a run.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Singh flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Good length delivery on off, Singh defends it off the back foot.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Who is in next to face the music? Simi Singh in at number 5.

OUT! Ireland lose their third wicket. They are in deep trouble now. Tossed up on middle, Stirling plays a slog sweep over mid-wicket. He does not get enough on it. Najibullah Zadran takes a comfortable catch near the boundary. So it takes just 5 balls for Nabi to strike.
Comes down the track to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Around off, defended from the crease.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Follows the batsman down the leg side, seeing him itching to go off side, Stirling still manages to push it towards point for a single.
Mohammad Nabi into the attack now.
FOUR! Good shot. Full on off, Thompson drives it through covers for a boundary. 10 runs and a wicket came from the over. 37/2 in the Powerplay.
Stuart Thompson walks in at number 4, replacing Balbirnie.

OUT! Balbirnie departs! Good length delivery on middle, Balbirnie looks to flick but gets hit on the pads due to the inward movement on this one. The bowler appeals and the umpire raises his finger immediately. Ireland lose their second wicket.
Good length delivery on off, Balbirnie defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Nice shot. Short of a length delivery, Balbirnie pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Stirling flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Length delivery on middle, Balbirnie tucks it towards mid-wicket. The fielder from mid-wicket goes for a direct hit at the bowler's end but misses it. The batsmen take a run.
Karim Janat introduced into the attack now.
Full and outside off, Stirling gets down to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. A mild LBW appeal goes up but the impact was outside off.
Floated on off, Stirling plays it towards mid off.
FOUR! Good improvisation from Paul Stirling. Flighted delivery on middle, Stirling gets down on one knee and plays a scoop over short fine leg for a boundary.
Andy Balbirnie comes in at number 3, replacing Kevin O'Brien.

OUT! Caught! There comes the first wicket. Mujeeb strikes. Full and following the batsman down the leg side, Kevin is cramped for room as he looks to play the lofted shot. He does go through with the same but does not quite get the distance he needed. The height is nice but not the distance. Simple catch for Mohammad Nabi at long on. Probably a wrong choice of a shot too. Could have gone off side as there was a long on and a deep mid-wicket in place.
Around off, swung towards square  leg for a single.
Full and down the leg side, fired on the pads, Stirling comes down the track but is beaten in flight. Is hit on the pads.
Full on middle and leg, Stirling drives it towards mid on for a run. Big over for Ireland. 11 runs came from it.
FOUR! Cracking shot. Short and outside off, Stirling smashes it hard through point for a boundary.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Stirling pulls it to mid-wicket.
Length delivery on off, Stirling gets on top of the bounce and cuts it to point.
Full again on off, Stirling drives it over covers. The batsmen pick up a couple.
FOUR! First boundary of the match. Nice Shot. Full and outside off, Stirling drives it hard over point for a boundary.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Stirling flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Around off, comes back in, Kevin looks to flick but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, O'Brien looks to drive but gets an inside edge. It goes towards square leg. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Floated on middle, Stirling flicks it towards square leg for a run.
The batsman has been struck on the pads as he looked to play that off the front foot. They pick up a single. The Umpire signals a leg bye.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Around off, coming in, Kevin looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. Takes a quick run.
The ball sneaks between the bat and body of the batsman.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
That is a beauty. On a good length around off, O'Brien looks to defend but the ball comes back in a long way and cuts him into half. Beats the inside edge and goes over the off stump.

EDGED, DROPPED! Big moment in the game. A length ball outside off, Stirling goes hard at the drive but gets a thick outside edge due to the extra bounce. Mohammad Nabi at first slip dives to his right but can only get a hand to it. Parries it to third man and the batsmen take a single.
Farid Malik to bowl from the other end.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. One run added to the total.
Full and around off, Stirling gets down to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. There is a massive shout from the Afghans but nothing in it. Probably the impact was outside off.
Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, O'Brien tucks it towards square leg for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman has been hit on the pads as he tried to sweep that one.
Starts with a tossed up delivery on middle, Stirling offers a forward defense on this one. It goes towards mid-wicket.
Time for the play to begin. Paul Stirling and Kevin O'Brien are opening for Ireland. Interesting pair. Mujeeb Ur Rahman to start off proceedings with the new ball. The skipper to face. Here we go!
TOSS - Paul Stirling gets his first call right as skipper. IRELAND WILL BAT FIRST.
WEATHER REPORT - It is heavily overcast and we can see a drop or two of rain. There is some wet weather forecast, so do not rule out interruptions.

A picturesque Himalayan range welcomes us all to this wonderful Thursday evening. Of course, the thing is that in such beautiful places, the temperature dips down pretty quickly. Still, not bad conditions to play cricket. But aren't India playing  Australia from Sunday? Oh no o no, this is a neutral series between Afghanistan and Ireland in Dehradun. The series starts with 3 T20Is, then shifts to 5 ODIs before eventually, a one-off Test. Should be fun. Welcome to one and all.
